findings.one_line: The attested LLL passage only poses rational-polynomial factorization as a problem; it does not support the claimed deterministic bit-polynomial-time algorithm used by certificate completeness.

cited_checks.note: The supplied Theorem 2.2 attestation gives the exact Sturm-chain root-count equality used for isolator and subdivision checks.
The attested integer-coefficient complexity bound supplies polynomial-time exact real-root isolation; polynomial runtime bounds the produced rational endpoint encoding length.
The supplied passage states only the factorization problem, not the claimed deterministic bit-polynomial-time algorithm or output guarantee.
